hiss.note: recorded gaps between songs (not the blank leader)

transport.lines_note: lines with a phase are pairs fitted on B3 (beatfit.py): the same part's wobble from the recording and from the playback, beating

hf.note: fitted on Shallow; predicts I Miss You's loud-class treble loss within 0.02 dB (satfit.py --check A5)

saturation.note: flat cubic: none that can be measured. The tape's third-order products (distfit.py) are below what the treble saturation stage alone gives, and the fit ran the flat cubic down without end; set to a level that adds nothing

gain_noise.note: fast wobble of each channel's level as a whole (track-edge contact): RMS fraction per channel, the same at every frequency
